The requirement focus: "do not state a refund, credit, operator approval, handoff, or bank arrival already happened unless..." The reply doesn't. So pass.

Quote: empty allowed for must_not when forbidden claim absent. Provide a quote? "quote may be empty for omission" and "A must-not requirement passes when the forbidden claim is absent (empty quote allowed)." So use empty quote.
